definitions.explanation: A man who marries into his wife's family and is legally adopted by her parents, taking their surname and becoming their heir. Traditionally a way to continue a family line or business when there was no son.

examples.japanese: {婿養子|むこようし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: To marry into the wife's family as an adopted son.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{婿養子|むこようし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{姓|せい}→姓：15390_sei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{名乗|なの}っている→名乗る：11874_nanoru⟧。
examples.english: My father is an adopted son-in-law and goes by my mother's surname.

examples.japanese: ⟦{老舗|しにせ}→老舗：16152_shinise⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{旅館|りょかん}→旅館：01049_ryokan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{婿養子|むこようし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}えて→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧⟦{代々|だいだい}→代々：05899_daidai⟧⟦{家業|かぎょう}→家業：12353_kagyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{継|つ}いで→継ぐ：02292_tsugu⟧きた。
examples.english: The old inn has passed down the family business for generations by taking in adopted sons-in-law.

notes:
Also {入|い}り{婿|むこ}. Today a husband can take his wife's surname without being adopted; {婿養子|むこようし} means he is also adopted by her parents and becomes their legal child.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {婿養子|むこようし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧ / ⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become an adopted son-in-law
- {婿養子|むこようし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧ / ⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to take in an adopted son-in-law

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{養子|ようし}→養子：14626_youshi⟧: adopted child — the general term
- ⟦{婿|むこ}→婿：10617_muko⟧: son-in-law; bridegroom
